game.title: Green Bay Packers at New England Patriots

lede: New England Patriots carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#7 in EPA per play), while Green Bay Packers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#11 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it New England Patriots −5.5 with a fair total of 44.5 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is New England Patriots pass offence vs Green Bay Packers pass defence, which sits +0.165 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Green Bay Packers and New England Patriots have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
